summary: Athena Technology Acquisition Corp. II, a Delaware SPAC, held a virtual special meeting on September 10, 2026, and filed this 8-K reporting stockholder approval of its business combination with Ace Green Recycling Inc. Under a December 4, 2024 agreement, as amended March 19 and April 18, 2026, merger subsidiary Project Atlas Merger Sub Inc. will merge into Ace Green, which survives as a wholly owned Athena subsidiary. All proposals passed overwhelmingly: 9,835,040 votes for the business combination, zero against. Holders approved the post-combination charter, increased authorized shares to 115 million, and a related equity incentive plan. No price, premium, or closing date stated.
